title: Grade 2 Science — Mon, May 25
description: Animals Around Us — Day 1 of 5: Common animals and their names
subject: science

questions.question: Which animal gives us milk?
questions.explanation: A cow gives us milk! We drink cow's milk and make curd, butter, and cheese from it.

questions.question: Which animal can fly?
questions.explanation: Birds have wings and can fly. They have feathers and lay eggs.

questions.question: Which animal lives in water?
questions.explanation: Fish live in water. They breathe through gills and have fins to swim.

questions.question: Which animal is a pet that barks?
questions.explanation: A dog barks! Dogs are friendly pets that can be trained to help people.

questions.question: Which animal lays eggs?
questions.explanation: A hen (female chicken) lays eggs. Birds and most reptiles lay eggs.

questions.question: Which animal is the largest land animal?
questions.explanation: The elephant is the largest land animal. It has a long trunk and big ears.

questions.question: Which animal says 'meow'?
questions.explanation: A cat says 'meow'. Cats are quiet, clean pets that love to sleep!

questions.question: Which animal is known as the 'King of the Jungle'?
questions.explanation: The lion is called the King of the Jungle. Male lions have a big mane of hair around their face.

questions.question: Which animal has a very long neck?
questions.explanation: The giraffe has the longest neck of any animal. It uses its neck to eat leaves from tall trees.

questions.question: Which animal gives us wool?
questions.explanation: Sheep give us wool. Wool is used to make warm clothes like sweaters and blankets.

questions.question: Which animal is a very good swimmer?
questions.explanation: Fish are expert swimmers. Elephants are also surprisingly good swimmers!

questions.question: Which animal can live in very hot, dry deserts?
questions.explanation: A camel can live in hot, dry deserts. It stores water and fat in its hump.

questions.question: Which animal makes honey?
questions.explanation: Bees make honey. They collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey in their hive.

questions.question: Which bird cannot fly but can swim?
questions.explanation: Penguins cannot fly but are excellent swimmers. They live in cold Antarctica.

questions.question: Which animal uses its tail to balance while jumping?
questions.explanation: A kangaroo uses its strong tail to balance when it hops. It also carries its baby in a pouch!
